neighbours.label: a collective noun in a quantity construction 'a [whole/broad] series/set/range/suite of ...', on the noun or the following 'of'
fire: The new law triggered a whole series of court challenges.
Engineers faced a complicated set of problems with the bridge.
The shop sells a wide range of garden tools.
Her research draws on a broad suite of computer models.
Critics raised a host of objections to the plan.
The report outlines a series of steps to cut emissions.
There is a whole array of options for new students.
The museum holds a large collection of early maps.
quiet: My favourite crime series ends next week on television.
She bought a new chess set for her nephew.
Snow covered the whole mountain range by November.
The hotel booked us into a suite on the top floor.
Our host greeted us at the door with tea.
He climbed the steps to the old lighthouse.
The solar array on the roof powers the whole house.
The garbage collection is every Thursday morning.
